# opnsense_core_hasync (Resource)

Manages OPNsense High Availability synchronization settings, including pfsync state replication and optional XMLRPC configuration synchronization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disable_preempt` (Boolean) When enabled, a recovering preferred CARP node does not preempt an already active master.
- `disconnect_ppps` (Boolean) When enabled, PPP-type interfaces are disconnected while this node is a CARP backup.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password used for XMLRPC configuration synchronization.
- `pfsync_defer` (Boolean) When enabled, transmission of the first packet in a state is deferred until the peer acknowledges insertion.
- `pfsync_interface` (String) Logical interface used to synchronize firewall states with pfsync. An empty value disables pfsync.
- `pfsync_peer_ip` (String) Optional unicast IPv4 peer used for pfsync state synchronization.
- `pfsync_version` (String) pfsync compatibility version: `1301` for OPNsense 24.1 or below, or `1400` for OPNsense 24.7 or above.
- `sync_items` (Set of String) OPNsense HA synchronization section identifiers to replicate through XMLRPC, such as `virtualip`, `rules`, or `nat`.
- `synchronize_to_ip` (String) Address or URL of the peer that receives selected configuration sections through XMLRPC synchronization. Leave empty on the backup node or when Terraform manages both peers independently.
- `username` (String) Username used for XMLRPC configuration synchronization.
- `verify_peer` (Boolean) When enabled, verify TLS for the XMLRPC synchronization peer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier `core_hasync`.
